ModMetaData.name: Jawa Scavenger Events
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
RUT_SCAVENGEREVENTS_BUILD_1. Our own IncidentWorkers for the map events Mo'Events (mlie.moevents) offered, ported behavior-not-bugs from a decompile of MoreIncidents.dll (see infrastructure/state/items/ RUT_SCAVENGEREVENTS_BUILD_1.md for the mechanism reference this was built from). Own letter text, own defNames, own baseChance settings. Scope is 7 of the original 8 mechanisms (RescueTraitor CUT by owner ruling 2026-09-11 -- its real mechanism was a half-decompiled body-horror mimicry/reveal, not a plain rescue). Retires mlie.moevents once the 7 are proven-fires.
MoreIncidents.dll ships under the MIT License (Copyright (c) 2020 Mlie, verified against the donor's own LICENSE.md/About.xml, 2026-09-25) -- permissive, no separate continuation-license restriction found. This mod's IncidentWorkers are re-authored C# (own class/field names, own guessed API signatures confirmed against Assembly-CSharp.dll) built from a read of the decompiled IL's behavior, not copied source; MIT attribution is recorded here regardless, per the license's own notice requirement.
